name: bitbucket-mcp
description: Bitbucket Cloud MCP server: read tools plus an audited, allowlisted set of PR write tools — comment (general, inline, multi-line, @-mention, reply), edit your comments, resolve / reopen threads, approve / request-changes / withdraw, create, and update (title, description, reviewers, draft, destination). No merge/decline/delete, by construction.
author: Ethan Ratnofsky
